simplified_output.simple_explanation: You have type 2 diabetes. Your HbA1c test result is 8.2%, which means your blood sugar has been too high.
important_instructions: Check your blood sugar levels as directed by your doctor
medication_guidance: Take metformin 500 mg twice daily with meals
Do not skip doses even if you feel fine
follow_up: Call if blood sugar readings are consistently above 250

results.original_chunk: Blood pressure readings consistently elevated at 158/94 mmHg. Initiated on lisinopril 10 mg once daily for hypertension management. Patient counseled on sodium restriction and regular exercise.

simplified_output.simple_explanation: Your blood pressure is too high at 158/94 mmHg. Normal blood pressure should be less than 120/80.
important_instructions: Limit salt in your diet to less than 2000 mg per day
Exercise for at least 30 minutes most days of the week
medication_guidance: Take lisinopril 10 mg once daily at the same time each day
This medication helps lower your blood pressure
follow_up: Check blood pressure at home daily and keep a log
Return in 2 weeks to check how the medication is working

retrieved_references.content: Stage 2 hypertension is defined as systolic ≥140 or diastolic ≥90
